stem: Which statement correctly describes the forces that affect the student’s position and motion?

options.label: A
options.text: The force of gravity causes the student to speed up from Position A to Position B.

options.label: B
options.text: The force of gravity causes the student to speed up from Position B to Position C.

options.label: C
options.text: The force of the student’s legs moving causes the motion to stop at Position B.

options.label: D
options.text: The force of the student pulling on the swing causes the motion to stop at Position A.

visual_elements: diagram of a student on a swing with three positions labeled Position A, Position B, Position C
notes: The problem is from 2024, question 26, standard 3.7(B). The diagram labels are preserved as Position A, Position B, Position C.
